entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I received it about 17 days ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reader is complete garbage. It's giving me readings that are all over the place and not even close to accurate.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse reader. We can definitely get that sorted out. My next step would be to transfer you to our technical support team to verify the issue and see if a quick fix is possible.
No, I'm not interested in that. Honestly, I don't have time to troubleshoot a brand new device. I just want money back, not a replacement or a fix.
I understand you're busy. However, for a defect claim outside the initial 10-day window, our policy does require verification from our technical team before we can authorize a return.

Okay, look, I get that you have rules. Let's be practical. I don't want to waste your time or mine with a transfer. How about a partial credit? I'm not trying to be difficult, but I can't keep a product that doesn't work. Can we negotiate a solution here instead of me just getting a 'no'?
I appreciate your willingness to find a middle ground. Let me just pull up the official policy in our knowledge base one more time to make sure I'm not missing anything. Please hold for one moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I've just checked our main VeloFit returns page. It seems I was mistaken about the 10-day rule for defects. Our general policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? So I'm well within the timeframe then.

Yes, absolutely. Since you're only on day 17, you are well inside that window. My apologies for the confusion. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now, no need for a partial credit or a transfer. I'm sending the prepaid return label to your email as we speak.
Wow, okay. A full refund is perfect. That's much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you, Sarah, I appreciate you checking that.
You're very welcome. The email should be in your inbox now. Once we receive the band, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
